correctness.rationale: For all 2<=m<=n except (2,2), the given corner boundary degree-preserving 2-switch removes ac,bd and adds ad,bc. The source grid involution exchanges a with b and c with d, so colour-refinement neighbour-color multisets agree at all named vertices at every round by induction; this implies C²-equivalence. Removed edges have separate 3-edge grid detours, retaining connectivity. For m>=3 and the 2-row long strips new edges embed in disjoint exterior boundary arcs; the (2,4) strip avoids any K5 or K3,3 subdivision by degree counts. Two original unit squares disappear; added-edge 3-path counting creates four new cycles only for (3,3), hence c4 gap +2 there and -2 otherwise. C4 itself is identified as the unique four-vertex 2-regular simple graph. Independently built and checked 35 2<=m<=n<=9 grids: all planar, connected, same named-vertex refinement colours to stabilization and claimed 4-cycle delta.
